# 2021B Question 8 {.unnumbered}

::: {.exam-question}
## Question {.question-label}

[**Describe**]{.task-verb} the effects of sevoflurane on the respiratory system.
:::

Also asked in: [2018B Question 3](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/3/index.qmd#examiner-comments)

:::: {#answer-structure}

## Suggested Structure

[**Describe**]{.task-verb} dose-dependent effects by respiratory function. Include breathing pattern and ventilatory response curves, then relate airway, muscle and pulmonary vascular effects to clinical consequences.

::: {.structure-headings}
### Upper Airway Tone and Reflexes

### Respiratory Rate, Tidal Volume and Minute Ventilation

### Responses to Carbon Dioxide and Hypoxaemia

### Bronchial Smooth Muscle and Respiratory Muscles

### Pulmonary Circulation and Other Effects
